rows.grounds: compound of pāraṇa (fast-breaking) and divasa (day), locative singular
past participle of prāp (arrive), locative absolute sense
compound of go (cow) and mukha (face), accusative singular
fused kārayet (causative optative, make) with priye (vocative dear one); sandhi fusion not marked with @

items.question: What should be made on the fast-breaking day once it has arrived, dear one?
premises: a cow-face is to be made
the instruction is addressed to the dear one
items.inference: on the fast-breaking day, once it has arrived, one should make a cow-face
uncertainties: whether prāpte is a locative absolute or adjective modifying the day
whether kārayetpriye is one fused token or two words in the edition
items.plain_english: On the fast-breaking day, once it has arrived, make a cow-face, dear one.
